trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The description combines two things: a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle, knocking someone down. As general strategy, drive slowly past a target so the melee connects without the vehicle itself doing the work, and retry in quieter spots until it registers.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. The description names both the total and the method, so route marked bills through your contacts whenever the option appears rather than spending them elsewhere. This is a long accumulation trophy: start it early, keep laundering steadily, and let the total build across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The description counts spending in shops generally, so ordinary purchases throughout the game all contribute. As general strategy, do not hoard cash pointlessly: buy what you need as you play, and make a deliberate spending pass in the money stage of the roadmap if the total is still short.
